turns.customer: Hi, can you groom really big dogs?
blocks:
Yes. Happy Tails lists full grooming for dogs in the **81–99 lb** size range, starting at **$105**, and for **Doodles of any listed size**, starting at **$111**. The groomer assesses each dog’s coat and care needs, so the final price may vary. For dogs over 99 lb, the published rate sheet doesn’t list a size category—Happy Tails staff can clarify at **(512) 764-6150**.

If you share your dog’s weight and breed, I can help identify the listed starting rate.

turns.customer: Full groom for my Great Pyrenees Yeti, he's 120 lbs. How much?
blocks: Happy Tails lists full-groom starting rates only through **81–99 lb ($105+)**. Since Yeti is **120 lb**, that rate doesn’t establish his price; the published rates don’t specify a starting rate for his weight. Happy Tails staff can clarify at **(512) 764-6150**.
